name: SERGIO bifurcation matrix
description: SERGIO differentiation graph matrix consumed as bifurcation_matrix when dynamics=True. Entry i,j is the non-negative migration rate from source bin i to child bin j.
validation_notes: The file must contain a square number_bins by number_bins numeric matrix.
Entries must be non-negative; zero means no differentiation transition.
SERGIO assumes an acyclic differentiation graph and at most one parent per bin.
The matrix dimensions must match the number_bins simulator parameter and the number of rate columns in sergio_master_regulators.
